title: MIND THE GAP: HOW ELICITATION PROTOCOLS SHAPE THE STATED-REVEALED PREFERENCE GAP IN LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, faith, or religious groups. The study focuses on general ethical and operational values like truthfulness, privacy, and justice in language models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the stated-revealed (SvR) preference gap in language models, specifically the mismatch between abstract values models endorse and the choices they make in contextualized moral dilemmas. It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
